title: An opaque room reveals itself while a PC is inside and re-hides when he leaves
source: Re-hiding a room when the party leaves (phase 1 vision, optional)
description: The room is an opaque rect zone, 6x6 at [10, 10] (x 7..13, y 7..13), with visible_to a formula over the pcs inside it. goblin1 (visible_to all) stands inside at [10, 10]; goblin2 (visible_to all) stands outside at [20, 20]. The room's z is 1 and the goblins' 0, so the cover is stated to lie over goblin1 rather than left to a default. Aldric's token (tag pc) enters at [9, 10] and leaves to [0, 0]. Then, with Aldric inside, the GM types all over visible_to: the override stops the formula, so leaving no longer re-hides; clearing it resumes the formula.

expect.note: "visible_to = if(len(contents(this).where(tag has "pc")) > 0, all, gm)": no pc inside, so gm.
Before entry the room is hidden from Aldric. The room's visible_to is gm.

DESIGN §4.4: a viewer who cannot see the zone sees its region drawn as a solid cover over everything beneath it, including objects they could otherwise see. The goblin is marked all but stands under the hidden opaque room.
DESIGN §4.4: the GM always sees everything.
The GM always sees everything.
The goblin outside the room is under no cover.
visible_to follows its formula; no one has typed over it.

steps.note: Aldric's token walks into the room.

expect.note: "visible_to = if(len(contents(this).where(tag has "pc")) > 0, all, gm)": a pc is inside, so all.
"Such a room is revealed by a PC token entering it."
The room is visible to Aldric, so it covers nothing for him; the goblin's own all applies.
"visible_to = if(len(contents(this).where(tag has "pc")) > 0, all, gm)": no pc inside, so gm.
"Re-hiding a room when the party leaves": with no pc inside the formula gives gm again. The room's visible_to is gm.

The room is visible to Aldric, so it covers nothing for him; the goblin's own all applies.

steps.note: The GM sets the room's visible_to to all by hand.

expect.note: "Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so." The inspector's override marker is on.
The override's value.
visible_to is all.

steps.note: Aldric leaves; the room stays revealed.

expect.note: "Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so." The formula would give gm, but the override holds all.
"Setting `visible_to` by hand would create an override and stop the formula; the inspector says so."
FIXTURES §9: moving the PC out no longer re-hides the room.
The room is visible, so it covers nothing; the goblin's own all applies.

steps.note: The GM clears the override; the formula resumes.

expect.note: "the inspector says so": no override now.
"visible_to = if(len(contents(this).where(tag has "pc")) > 0, all, gm)": no pc inside, so gm.
The formula is back and no pc is inside, so the room re-hides. The room's visible_to is gm.
